correctness.rationale: The unit-circle affine functional lemma forces either at most two proportional row classes or at most two proportional column classes for every modulus-one rank-two matrix. Character proportionality is equivalent exactly to the defined annihilator cosets. In the 3p case fibers of residue mod p have only three elements; the two disjoint pure-mod-3/mixed-two-mod-p alternatives each count 3*C(p,4)*15*C(p,2). Finite N6 and N21 exact modular rank checkers corroborate, with prime-product cyclotomic norm justification; none is used to infer universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: Uniform low-rank Fourier identifiability on every finite abelian group is characterized by elementary subgroup coset counts rather than determinant searches. This sharp cutoff at rank two yields a complete, previously unprovided infinite 4x4 rank-two census and occurrence classification for every 3p with p>=5, relevant to multiband Fourier sampling and defect diagnosis.
